sources.entry: SoftMaker Office - A complete office suite that aims for full compatibility with Microsoft Office documents.

summary.name: SoftMaker Office NX
summary.one_liner: SoftMaker Office is a German office suite with word processing (TextMaker), spreadsheets (PlanMaker) and presentations (Presentations) that uses DOCX, XLSX and PPTX as native formats and runs locally on the device.
use_cases: replace Microsoft Office with a compatible suite
edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files without conversion
create presentations with slides and transitions
work on documents across PC, Mac and mobile devices
summary.what_it_does: TextMaker handles documents of any length and uses DOCX as its native format, while PlanMaker handles spreadsheets and charts with XLSX as its native format. Presentations creates slides with animations and transitions and uses PPTX natively. The suite runs locally on the device without a forced cloud connection, and the page highlights GDPR compliance. Recent features listed include dynamic arrays and XLOOKUP in PlanMaker, Markdown import and export in TextMaker, LanguageTool and Duden Korrektor grammar checking, QR codes, and optional AI features such as ChatGPT text help, AI image generation and slide generation.
notable: Native DOCX, XLSX and PPTX formats for direct Microsoft Office compatibility
Runs locally with no hidden tracking or forced cloud connection, GDPR focus
Same suite on desktop and mobile, with mobile use included in the subscription
Integrated ChatGPT, AI image creation and LanguageTool grammar checking
caveats: Access is through a subscription; the page says new versions are included as part of the subscription
AI features such as ChatGPT and image generation are integrated features described on the page; their terms and any extra cost are not stated
The page does not give specific prices
